questions.cardDe: Was ist keine Risotto-Reissorte: Carnaroli, Vialone oder Anellini?
questions.de: Was für ein Lebensmittel sind Anellini – anders als die Risotto-Reissorten Carnaroli und Vialone?
questions.en: What kind of food are anellini, unlike the risotto rice varieties Carnaroli and Vialone?

timeline.labelEn: Ring-shaped anelli pasta is documented in southern Italy
timeline.labelDe: Ringförmige Anelli-Nudeln sind in Süditalien belegt

questions.notes: Card answer: Anellini (no risotto rice). Anellini are tiny soup-pasta rings; anelli are documented from the 1930s (it.wikipedia Anelli (pasta)).
